business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Biocompatible Dental Ceramic Blocks and Milling Discs

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (unitary national jurisdiction; registered office in Port Vila or Luganville)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law precedent, French civil law heritage, and recognised customary law; consolidated in the Revised Laws of Vanuatu)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, 2017, in force 2020)
Vanuatu - Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2020 (AML/CFT Act) as amended; International Companies Act [Cap 222], as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2016 (mandatory beneficial-ownership records); Financial Transactions Reporting Act 1999 (predecessor regime, in part superseded by the AML/CFT Act 2020); VFSC AML/CFT Rulebooks and VFSC Guidance Notes on Customer Due Diligence.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarial copy of each ultimate beneficial owner's and director's passport and proof of residential address
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the owner's/director's country of origin, countersigned by the VFSC-licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a Contracting Party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; chain: notarization, competent authority certification in origin state, then Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and/or Vanuatu consular legalization; certain Vanuatu banks may accept an Apostille only as an internal verification aid)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration for each subscribing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution maintaining the shareholder's account(s)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus Consular Legalization for Vanuatu-bound filing; apostille route inapplicable to Vanuatu-bound public documents

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation, certificate of good standing, and register of directors for any corporate shareholder or intermediate holding entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or licensed corporate services provider in the shareholder's domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille acceptable only for third-country intermediary verification; Vanuatu-bound acceptance requires notarized copy and, where filed with VFSC, consular legalization (Vanuatu not an Apostille Contracting State)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and continuous screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorised signatories against the UN Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists, HMT (UK) sanctions, Australian DFAT consolidated sanctions, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions measures under the AML/CFT Act 2020; Politically Exposed Persons (domestic and foreign, including family and close associates) are subject to enhanced due diligence, independent verification of source of wealth and funds, and compliance-officer sign-off; suspicious transaction reports are filed with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; screening is refreshed at annual agent renewal and upon any material ownership change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Companies Office - name clearance is lodged electronically via a VFSC-licensed registered agent through the VFSC e-Registry / agent portal; public search availability through the VFSC website company search
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The name must be expressed in Latin (Roman) script; a name in a foreign language or script must be accompanied by an approved romanised transliteration; the legal name must be distinguishable on the VFSC register and must end with a statutory corporate suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated', or 'Inc.'; misleading, offensive, or name-trading names are rejected.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the VFSC rejects a proposed name, the licensed registered agent may within 14 days of the refusal file a written appeal or application for ministerial/registrar consent together with supporting evidence of distinctiveness, trademark coexistence, or consent from the relevant supervisory authority; the VFSC Registrar must determine the appeal within 21 working days; a further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by originating application for judicial review under the Civil Procedure Rules.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physical registered office at the office of a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Vanuatu is mandatory under s. 55 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; a virtual/shared address cannot satisfy the statutory registered office. The dental zirconia block business may be managed remotely, but a Vanuatu International Company may not carry on manufacturing operations physically inside Vanuatu (such operations would require a domestic Vanuatu company and a Vanuatu Business Licence); the IC is best structured as the IP-holding and export-contracting entity with contract manufacturing performed offshore.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate (approximately 10-15% probability within any 12-month period) for a low-risk standard manufacturing/IP holding vehicle in the current risk tier; VFSC conducts risk-based unannounced or short-notice (48-hour) inspections of registered agent premises and company records; the 'requires_statutory_license' flag is satisfied by the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation for the IC, with any local business licence and medical-device conformance (e.g., ISO 13485) certification as downstream requirements.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 2, 4-6, 9-10, 27-29, 34-36; Companies (International Companies) Regulations 1993; International Companies (Amendment) Act 2009; Vanuatu Foreign Investment Act 2006; Civil Procedure Rules (Registry practice directions)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registry of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1: Memorandum and Articles of Association, with Statement of Particulars (Registered Office, Registered Agent, Directors, Secretary) and Consents to Act
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement for International Companies; authorized share capital commonly set at USD 10,000; shares may be issued in any currency or without par value; at least one share must be issued before registration
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: that the subscribers of the Company do hereby adopt the Memorandum and Articles of Association as presented and instruct the Registered Agent to file the same with the Registry of International Companies of the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission. FURTHER RESOLVED: that the registered office at [Agent Address], Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, be and is hereby approved as the Company's statutory registered office. FURTHER RESOLVED: that [Name] be appointed sole director and [Name] be appointed secretary. FURTHER RESOLVED: that the director be authorized to open bank accounts, issue share certificates, and execute all documents necessary to effect the incorporation and commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Availability Search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry of International Companies (submission via VFSC-licensed Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two to three proposed company names through a licensed Registered Agent using the VFSC prescribed name reservation request. The Registry conducts a search against the International Companies register and rejects names identical or confusingly similar to existing entities or names requiring consent (e.g. 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance'). Provide signed client instruction and fee payment.
required_dossiers: Name reservation request form
Passport copy of each subscriber/beneficial owner
AML/KYC questionnaire and source of funds declaration
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resubmit an alternative proposed name within 3 business days; if the Registry refuses a name erroneously, file a written request for reconsideration with the VFSC Registrar supported by a legal opinion; no additional state fee for resubmission of a corrected name within the same application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Appointment of Licensed Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC (Licensing and Fit-and-Proper oversight of Registered Agents)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a Registered Agent service agreement with a VFSC-licensed corporate services provider in Port Vila. The Registered Agent must maintain the statutory registered office in Vanuatu and file Form 3 (Consent of Registered Agent) with the VFSC. The agent performs client due diligence and collects certified identity documents.
required_dossiers: Registered agent services agreement
Corporate due diligence questionnaire
Certified passport copies of directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners
Bank reference or professional reference letter
Certificate of incorporation of corporate shareholder (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC rejects the agent's consent filing, execute a corrected consent or appoint a substitute licensed agent within 7 days; the company remains unformed until the consent is duly recorded; no monetary penalty applies at this pre-registration stage.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry (pre-registration review) and licensed legal counsel or notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association incorporating the mandatory clauses under the International Companies Act (object, share capital, limitation of liability, registered office, officer provisions). Subscribers execute the document before a witness; foreign subscribers may execute before a notary public with apostille or consular legalization if required by the agent's internal policy.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber resolution approving the draft
Witnessed or notarized execution pages
Proposed particulars of directors and secretary
Consent forms of proposed directors and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries a clause (e.g. unlawful object or defective share provision), instruct counsel to issue a revised draft and re-execute the affected schedule; the 14-day statutory correction window applies before formal rejection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Registration with the VFSC (Form 1 and Supporting Instruments)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Registered Agent submits the complete incorporation package comprising Form 1, signed Memorandum and Articles of Association, particulars of officers, consents, certified identity documents, and the government registration fee. The Registrar examines compliance and, if satisfied, issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique International Company number and date of registration.
required_dossiers: Form 1 (Application for Incorporation)
Signed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of Registered Agent (Form 3)
Consents of directors and secretary
Certified copies of identity and address proof for all officers and shareholders
Government fee receipt or bank transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a defect notice or letter of query, the agent files a corrective submission within 30 days of the query date; refusal of incorporation is appealable to the VFSC Board of Review; repeat amendments may attract a VUV 10,000 review fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Government Statutory Dues and Stamp Duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Revenue Section and Vanuatu Government Stamp Duty Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Settle the incorporation registration fee and any applicable stamp duty on the authorized share capital (where the authorized capital exceeds VUV 2,000,000). Payment is made by wire transfer to the VFSC official bank account or by direct deposit at the VFSC cashier; the receipt is retained as evidence of compliance.
required_dossiers: VFSC incorporation fee invoice
Bank wire transfer receipt or VFSC cashier receipt
Stamp duty assessment form (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fee is underpaid or receipt is lost, provide a sworn undertaking and bank statement showing the transfer; overpaid amounts are offset against the first annual renewal fee; no interest accrues for delayed refunds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance Setup and Corporate Book Completion
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent and Company Secretary (with VFSC annual filing obligations)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, prepare the corporate register (members, directors, secretary, charges), issue share certificates, adopt approved forms of share transfer and meeting minutes, record the organizational written resolution, and open the corporate bank account with banking due diligence documents.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Organizational board minutes or written resolutions
Share certificates and register of members
Register of directors and secretary
Registered agent acknowledgement of registered office
Bank account opening forms and corporate banking resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any omission in the corporate register by written resolution of the director; file a late particulars notification with the VFSC if an officer changes within the first year; civil penalty of VUV 5,000 per month applies only for failure to file the annual return, not for internal register corrections.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) jointly with the Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry, Co-operatives and Ni-Vanuatu Business
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Registration Certificate (FIRC) under the Vanuatu Foreign Investment Act 2006, combined with a Municipal Business (Trading) Licence issued by Port Vila City Council for manufacturing operations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Mandatory Environmental Review and Registration (listed small-scale manufacturing activity with low pollution potential); a full Environmental Impact Assessment is not required for dental ceramic block production below 5 t/day material throughput, but a project registration and environmental management plan must be approved.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must meet the national effluent standards under the Environment Protection Act 2003 (no untreated process water to public waterways; pH 6-9; biological oxygen demand below 30 mg/L); airborne particulate emissions limited to 50 mg/Nm³ for milling and polishing operations; zirconia dust handling must comply with occupational exposure limit of 5 mg/m³ (respirable); hazardous waste (uncured resin binders, contaminated solvents) must be stored in sealed containers and disposed through DEPC-approved waste contractors under the Waste Management Act 2001.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Compliance Certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (Port Vila) covering suppression systems, exits, and storage of combustible ceramics additives; Structural Load Inspection and Building Clearance from the Public Works Department confirming floor loading capacity for milling equipment; Occupational Health and Safety registration and workplace certificate from the Department of Labour, Vanuatu, including a safe work method statement for machinery guarding, dust extraction, and emergency protocols; Ministry of Health import/export clearance for biocompatible dental materials confirming conformity to ISO 13485 and ISO 6872 product standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), Port Vila; portal: http://www.vanuatucustoms.gov.vu and VFSC Registrar for International Companies

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax Act No. 11 of 1998)

mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate / Foreign Exchange Confirmation

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125]; exchange-control and foreign-currency administration powers are exercised by the RBV under the Exchange Control Act [Cap 54], while supervision of International Companies is vested in the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a substantially liberalised capital-account regime for non-resident-owned International Companies (ICs). Current-account payments for dental-block raw material imports and finished-good export receipts are unrestricted; there is no pre-shipment verification, no tariff-linked FX licensing, and no profit-remittance permit requirement. Capital-account transactions, including paid-up share capital injections, intercompany loans, and return of equity, are freely convertible when executed through an RBV-licensed commercial bank solely in foreign currency. Domestic commercial banks require only standard anti-money-laundering documentation and SWIFT-compliant purpose codes. The residual friction is not statutory but correspondent-driven: as a jurisdiction historically exposed to APG/FATF enhanced monitoring, VU-domiciled payment flows attract enhanced screening at beneficiary banks in the United States, Australia, and Europe.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender rule applies to VU International Companies. The Export Proceeds facet of the Exchange Control Act [Cap 54] is disapplied to ICs operating exclusively in foreign currency with non-residents; 100% of export proceeds from zirconia-block sales may be retained indefinitely in USD, EUR, AUD, or NZD accounts without conversion into Vanuatu Vatu (VUV), and there is no statutory time limit for repatriation into the VU banking system.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency current account (USD/EUR/AUD) plus segregated Capital Escrow/Deposit account for initial share-capital subscription
Operational foreign-currency corporate account with corporate saver sweeps; dedicated capital-escrow ledger acceptable
Operational foreign-currency account with strong EUR corridor for European dental-lab clients
Operational account; domestic retail orientation and constrained International Company onboarding appetite

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: MEDIUM with legal and operational constraints. Offshore digital EMIs regulated in Singapore, the UK, or the EU (for example Airwallex, Currencycloud, or Wise Business) may on-board a VU International Company that presents a VFSC registered agent certificate, certificate of incumbency, and standard beneficial-ownership declarations; such EMIs provide efficient USD/EUR/CNH payment rails for sub-USD 250,000 operational disbursements. Legal constraints: (i) EMIs are not licensed by the RBV and cannot open VUV accounts; (ii) prominent EMIs apply policy exclusion or enhanced due diligence to VU entities given Vanuatu's historical APG/FATF grey-list episodes, so approval is discretionary and account limits may be capped; (iii) EMI accounts are inadvisable as primary inbound capital-injection rails because they do not issue a local SWIFT branch address acceptable to correspondent banks for high-value FDI wires. Recommended structure: Tier-1 domestic bank for capital, trade settlements, and LC, plus one EMI as a low-value disbursement overlay.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-person appearance in Port Vila by at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner is the de facto mandate for first-time account opening at ANZ, BSP, and BRED; the bank conducts a face-to-face or time-stamped HD video interview, with VFSC-registered agents permitted to introduce the client under an introducer agreement. Remote opening is possible only when: (i) all identity documents are notarised and apostilled or consular-certified; (ii) the board resolution appointing signatories is fresh (less than 90 days old); (iii) the registered agent provides an AML/CFT comfort letter; and (iv) the interview is recorded and stored. Physical presence is strongly recommended to shorten approval times from 3-6 weeks to 7-10 business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial-ownership chain; IC law permits bearer shares and nominee arrangements, which banks treat as a high-risk red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Register of Members and Directors; Certificate of Incumbency dated within 30 days; VFSC Registered Agent's beneficial-ownership register extract; statutory declaration confirming no outstanding bearer shares and no nominee ambiguity; current VFSC corporate search.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source-of-wealth and source-of-funds insufficiency for the USD capital injection into a manufactured-goods company lacking onshore factory assets in Vanuatu.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed board resolution for share subscription; audited or accountant-certified financial statements of the subscribing shareholder; three months of bank statements evidencing accumulated funds; executed distribution and sales contracts for dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks; pro-forma invoices from materials suppliers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and correspondent-bank scrutiny over projected payments to the People's Republic of China and other Asia-Pacific suppliers of zirconia powder and milling equipment.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full counterparty schedule with names, jurisdictions, and bank identifiers; OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-screening results clearing all counterparties; end-user and no-re-export attestation for 5-axis milling machinery; purchase orders, packing lists, and bills of lading for recent shipments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Shell-company profile: a tax-exempt IC with no physical factory in Vanuatu, no employees, and a single registered-agent address.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC business-licence certificate and International Company certificate; ISO 13485:2016 quality-management certification for dental ceramics; medical-device registration documentation; operational substance letter from the VFSC agent detailing agent offices and records; commercial contracts evidencing an ongoing manufacturing-distribution model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO residing in a FATF-monitored jurisdiction or a country outside normal correspondent acceptance lists.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: UBO passport and proof-of-address; CRS-FATCA self-certification forms; professional reference from a licensed attorney in the UBO's home jurisdiction; personal tax-clearance certificate; declaration of business rationale for incorporating in Vanuatu.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route all share-capital injections exclusively through the segregated Capital Escrow/Deposit account held at ANZ or BSP in Port Vila. Instruct the shareholder's remitting bank to send an SWIFT MT103 with: beneficiary account name exactly matching the Certificate of Incumbency; tag 70 remittance information reading 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION - VU_IC - DENTAL CERAMIC BLOCK'; and a purpose code classified as 'Foreign Direct Investment / Equity Injection' rather than a goods-payment code. Require the executing bank to verify SWIFT RMA relationships with correspondent banks (generally JP Morgan Chase, New York, for USD; Commonwealth Bank of Australia for AUD; banks in Frankfurt/Paris for EUR). For injections above USD 250,000, provide the local bank with the capital subscription board resolution, UBO source-of-funds letter, and bank-statement evidence at least 48 hours before value date. EMIs must not be used for initial FDI wires.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For supplier payments under USD 500,000, use SWIFT MT103 (GPI trackable) segregated by purpose code 'Trade Settlement - Dental Ceramic Block Raw Materials' with PO and invoice references, cleared via the domestic bank's USD correspondent. For capital equipment (CAD/CAM milling units, sintering furnaces, ultrasonic scanners), issue an irrevocable sight Commercial Letter of Credit via MT700 from the ANZ/BSP Port Vila branch, with documents comprising the commercial invoice, full-set bill of lading, certificate of origin, phytosanitary or quality certificate where required, and ISO 13485 conformity statement; settlement occurs via MT202/MT103 cover through the correspondent network. A CAD escrow arrangement with a VFSC-licensed trust affiliate may be layered for milestone-based payments from major US/EU dental-lab distributors. Reconciliation is supported by SWIFT GPI end-to-end tracking and daily balance reporting over the local bank's electronic banking portal.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH non-deliverable forward (NDF) executed offshore with a licensed international dealer to hedge yuan-denominated Chinese supplier purchases; settle the difference outside Vanuatu under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement.
USD/EUR deliverable forward contract booked through an onshore authorised dealer (ANZ or BSP Port Vila) to hedge European dental-lab receivable tenors up to 12 months.
USD/AUD currency forward or dual-currency swap with a Tier-1 onshore dealing bank to hedge VUV-excluded operating costs in Port Vila.
Cross-currency interest-rate swap (USD versus EUR or CNH) with an investment-grade international counterparty to transform the capital structure of trade-finance facilities.

Vanuatu offers no onshore VUV derivatives market and the RBV imposes no dealing restriction on ICs using offshore hedging instruments; all such derivatives must be documented under ISDA/CSA or a local-law security deed enforceable in Vanuatu courts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form 12 / Annual Declaration of Compliance)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 2,500 (≈US$20) plus continued default; failure beyond 3 months triggers administrative strike-off and loss of legal personality.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Fee / Renewal of Certificate of Incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due on each anniversary of incorporation, payable within 30 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment incurs late penalty and suspension of the certificate; unabated arrears for 6 months result in deregistration and compulsory winding-up.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Furnished annually together with the Annual Return; any UBO or shareholding change ≥10% reported within 14 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain accurate UBO records attracts fines up to VT 500,000 (≈US$4,000) and, for continuing breach, strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory audit threshold for a standard non-regulated International Company (IC). An independent audit is triggered only (i) by a shareholders' resolution requiring audited accounts, or (ii) by holding a VFSC-regulated licence (e.g., banking, insurance, securities).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for regulated financial services; otherwise, ordinary ICs must maintain accounting records under an internationally accepted GAAP sufficient to disclose a true and fair view. No audited financial statement is required to be filed with VFSC for a standard IC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain and inspect the central UBO register. Each annual return declares, under officer penalty, that the UBO register continues to be accurate. Any shareholding transfer exceeding 10% or any change in ultimate beneficial owner must be reported to VFSC within 14 days.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$600 – US$1,200 per annum for registered office, registered agent, and compliance support
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit required; if voluntarily shareholder-requested, typical Vanuatu standard audit for a manufacturing international company is US$4,000 – US$8,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax; an International Company is statutorily exempt from all income tax)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full tax-exempt status for International Companies; no corporate tax, no capital gains tax, no payroll tax; only fixed government registration fees and annual business licence fees apply

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return is prescribed; annual compliance is effected through the VFSC Annual Return and Business Licence renewal filed via the licensed registered agent or the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual Return must be filed within one month of the anniversary of incorporation or as directed by the registered agent; Business Licence renewal is due by 31 December each year

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annual Return – Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and VFSC registration number of the International Company
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the Certificate of Incorporation exactly; non-resident beneficial owners are not disclosed on this form

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Annual Return – Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu address and contact details of the licensed registered agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A registered office and agent in Vanuatu are mandatory; provide agent details rather than any foreign operational address

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the core business: manufacture and wholesale of dental CAD/CAM zirconia blocks and milling discs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the actual Vanuatu-facing activity; foreign manufacturing and offshore sales should be described as non-domestic trading activity to preserve exemption

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated gross revenue used for licence fee calculation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare only turnover attributable to Vanuatu operations; properly ring-fenced offshore revenue is outside the Vanuatu licence fee base

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the Annual Return triggers VFSC late lodgement penalties, potential strike-off, and restoration costs; failure to renew the Business Licence subjects the company to monetary penalties and renders continued trading unlawful

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (no dividend withholding tax applies to distributions from an International Company)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement network; consequently there is no domestic DTA relief procedure or tax residency certificate protocol. A foreign shareholder must rely on the foreign jurisdiction's unilateral foreign-tax-credit, CFC, or anti-abuse rules; no form of Vanuatu treaty relief filing is available
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalties and debt interest is 0%; no treaty-reduced rates are available in the absence of applicable double tax treaties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable; Vanuatu national tax law imposes no transfer-pricing documentation, Local File, Master File, or benchmark study requirements
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu's Economic Substance Regulations target geographically mobile financial activities such as banking, insurance, financing, shipping, intellectual property, and headquarters services; a manufacturing entity holding inventory and conducting dental zirconia block production outside Vanuatu is generally outside that scope. Nevertheless, adequate commercial substance is advisable to prevent foreign CFC recharacterisation or anti-tax-haven measures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the tax-exempt Vanuatu International Company as a conduit to misrepresent income, conceal beneficial ownership, or shift profits from a taxable foreign dental-block manufacturing operation in order to evade foreign corporate tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign tax authorities may raise additional assessments, impose penalties of up to 100–200% of the avoided tax, recharacterise the entity as a CFC, and compel production of transactional documents; Vanuatu authorities may strike off the company for filing false information with the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute sham arrangements face foreign civil restitution, personal assessment, criminal fraud sanctions, and potential imprisonment in the taxing jurisdiction; Vanuatu itself does not imprison directors for foreign tax evasion but may disbar them from acting as directors

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining an International Company with nominee directors, no physical office, no employees, and no economic activity while claiming tax-exempt or foreign treaty benefits inconsistent with the actual commercial substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the International Companies Act, the VFSC may suspend or revoke the company's registration, order compulsory deregistration, and vest its assets; the company loses the legal capacity to contract and its bank accounts may be frozen
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu company, subject to civil penalty orders, and foreign courts may pierce the corporate veil, impose criminal liability for sham transactions, and issue travel bans pending asset recovery

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Swift-wire or TT payment proceeds from dental consumable sales without conducting customer due diligence, maintaining beneficial-ownership and transaction records, or transacting with sanctioned counterparties
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act, penalties include fines up to VT 75,000,000 per contravention, freezing orders, confiscation of proceeds, and suspension or revocation of the company's licence by the VFSC
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and senior managers are personally liable for AML failures; sanctions include imprisonment of up to 10 years, personal monetary penalties, travel bans, and disqualification from corporate management
